text: On that day you will say: “I thank you, ADONAI, because, although you were angry at me, your anger is now turned away; and you are comforting me.
“See! God is my salvation. I am confident and unafraid; for Yah ADONAI is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation!”
Then you will joyfully draw water from the springs of salvation.
On that day you will say, “Give thanks to ADONAI! Call on his name! Make his deeds known among the peoples, declare how exalted is his name.
Sing to ADONAI, for he has triumphed — this is being made known throughout the earth.
Shout and sing for joy, you who live in Tziyon; for the Holy One of Isra’el is with you in his greatness!”
